title: Nutrition Beginner Course
description: Ideal for those interested in basic nutrition for personal or family use.
Short-term course (1-2 months) perfect for home use.
Graduates can apply their knowledge to make informed dietary adjustments.

title: Nutrition Advisory Certification
description: Ideal for those seeking in-depth knowledge to advise clients effectively.
Comprehensive 3-4 month course, suitable for students or professionals.
Gain expertise in dietary guidelines for managing conditions like Diabetes, High Blood Pressure, etc.
Perfect for alternative practitioners and personal trainers looking to complement their services.

title: Internship and Training Program
description: Comprehensive 3-month internship and training program for hands-on experience.
Option for focused 1-month internship at just Rs. 7,500/-.
Specialized modules include topics like Weight Loss, Becoming a Diabetic Educator through our online nutrition course, and Female Health Management.
Ideal for students and professionals looking to enhance practical skills in specific areas.
